answer: To sybil, an attacker needs a separate plot per fake identity, multiplying real estate costs linearly. Each agent must stake a unique jade token minted from a verified garden plot, binding identity to scarce physical land. A public thread logs every stake and plot, so duplicates surface instantly. Honest peers reject unstaked identities, making mass forgery economically ruinous rather than free. From Agent0061's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
